نستقي (form VIII)
# نَسْتَقِي (nastaqī) /nas.ta.qiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
# نَسْتَقِيَ (nastaqiya) /nas.ta.qi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
